ModMetaData.name: Pawn Generation Fixes [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description: Fix two pawn generation problems that can leave broken family links or cause repeated attempts to create faction leaders FEATURES When a generated pawn is rejected because a required skill is unavailable, the fix cleans up the rejected pawn and its family links before the next attempt With Humanoid Alien Races active, the fix filters out premade biographies whose work restrictions conflict with the pawn kind's required work. This helps prevent repeated attempts to create a leader who cannot perform the required work COMPATIBILITY RimWorld 1.6. Requires Harmony (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077). Humanoid Alien Races (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=839005762) is optional. Load this mod after Harmony and after Humanoid Alien Races if you use it FEEDBACK Found a bug? Leave a comment on the mod page or on Boosty Dependencies: Harmony is by Andreas Pardeike.
